description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No. 11 of 2021 Order under Section 53
reasoning: This gazette content is an Order made under Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, specifying tax exemptions and incentives for a designated business. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that modifies the application of multiple existing laws (Inland Revenue Act, VAT Act, Customs Ordinance, etc.) for a specific entity. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
